context: SFT preflight check 6b (400-step memory soak) FAILED its own threshold: MPS pool reached 10.92 GB > 10 GB guard. That soak runs in a process that has also built and trained a second (overfit) trainer, so it overstates a real training process.

fresh_process_measurement.what: 600 real training steps with configs/sft/m6_3_sft_30m.toml (pad to 64, torch.mps.empty_cache every 25 steps) in a fresh process, i.e. exactly what scripts/train_sft.py runs

decision: Proceed with every M5 memory safeguard unchanged (padding to 64, cache release every 25 steps, abort if pool > 10 GB). MPS recommended maximum is 12.7 GB. If the guard trips, the run stops safely and is reported; no threshold was raised.
